transcript.en: Before we start, Spiros and Hiroko, thanks for coming in today to talk about your recent study experiences and congratulations to you both in doing so well in your first semester exams!
transcript.zh: 在我们开始之前，感谢Spiros和Hiroko能在今天来这里讲讲你们最近的学习经历，并祝贺两位在第一学期的考试中取得了好成绩！

transcript.en: I'd like to discuss with you the value of the English for Academic Purposes course you did here last year before starting your university course.
transcript.zh: 我想与你们探讨在你们上大学之前，去年在这里学的学术英语课程的价值。

transcript.en: Spiros, if I could start with you, what parts of the programme have now proved to be particularly valuable to you?
transcript.zh: Spiros，如果可以从你开始的话，项目的哪部分现在证明对你很有价值？

transcript.en: I think that having to do a seminar presentation really helped me.
transcript.zh: 我觉得研讨会演讲对我很有帮助

transcript.en: For example, a couple of weeks ago in our marketing subject, when it was my turn to give presentation, I felt quite confident.
transcript.zh: 例如，几周前当我们的营销专业轮到我演讲时，我感觉很自信。

transcript.en: Of course, I was still nervous but because I had done one before, I knew what to expect.
transcript.zh: 当然，我仍感到紧张，但是因为我之前做过，所以我知道会发生什么。

transcript.en: Also, I know I was well prepared and I had practised my timing.
transcript.zh: 而且我知道我准备充分，并练习控制时间。

transcript.en: In fact, I think that in relation to some of the other people in my group, I did quite a good job because my overall style was quite professional.
transcript.zh: 事实上，我认为相比我们组的其他人，我做得很好。因为我的整体风格都很专业。

transcript.en: What about you Hiroko?
transcript.zh: 你呢 Hiroko

transcript.en: Mmm, that's interesting.
transcript.zh: 很有趣

transcript.en: In my group, I was really surprised by the way the students did their presentations - they just read the notes aloud.
transcript.zh: 在我的小组，我对同学们做演讲的方式感到惊讶，他们只是大声地读出他们的笔记，

transcript.en: Can you believe that?
transcript.zh: 你能相信吗

transcript.en: They didn't worry about their presentation style or keeping eye contact with their audience - and I remember that these things were really stressed to us in the course here.
transcript.zh: 他们不担心自己的演讲风格，也不和听众做眼神交流。我记得在这里上课时，这些事情对我们都很重要。

transcript.en: So, how did you approach your presentation Hiroko?
transcript.zh: 那么，Hiroko，你是如何演讲的？

transcript.en: Well, to speak frankly, I read my notes too.
transcript.zh: 坦白地说，我也读了我的笔记！

transcript.en: At the time, it was a relief to do it this way, but actually when I had finished, I didn't feel any real sense of satisfaction.
transcript.zh: 当时这么做让人感觉很放松，但是其实当我结束后，我没有感到任何的满足感。

transcript.en: I didn't feel positive about the experience at all.
transcript.zh: 我并不觉得这是个积极的经历

transcript.en: That's a pity.
transcript.zh: 真是一种遗憾

transcript.en: You know although I was pleased with my presentation, I'm not so pleased with my actual performance right now in the tutorials - during the whole semester I've not said anything in our tutorial discussions.
transcript.zh: 尽管我对我的演讲满意，但是我不满意我在课堂上的实际表现。整个学期我在讨论课上一言未发。

transcript.en: Not a word.
transcript.zh: 一个字也没说过。

transcript.en: Really, Spiros, why's that?
transcript.zh: 是吗？为什么会这样？

transcript.en: Do the other students talk too much?
transcript.zh: 其他学生说的太多了吗？

transcript.en: It's partly that, but it's mostly because I have had no confidence to speak out.
transcript.zh: 有一部分是这个原因，但是多数是因为我没有勇气畅所欲言。

transcript.en: Their style of speaking is so different - it's not the style we were used to during the course.
transcript.zh: 他们的讲话风格与我们上课时的风格很不一样

transcript.en: They use so many colloquialisms, they're not very polite and sometimes there seems to be no order in their discussion.
transcript.zh: 他们用很多的口语，他们不是很有礼貌，有时他们的讨论似乎没有秩序。

transcript.en: Also they are very familiar with each other, so because they know each other's habits, they can let each other into the discussion.
transcript.zh: 而且，他们对彼此很熟悉，所以他们知道彼此的习惯，也就很容易让对方加入讨论。

transcript.en: You're right, Spiros.
transcript.zh: 你说得对

transcript.en: I've experienced that too.
transcript.zh: Spiros，我也有这种体会，

transcript.en: For most of this semester, I've said absolutely nothing in tutorials.
transcript.zh: 在这个学期的多数时间里，我在课上都没有说过话。

transcript.en: But recently I've been trying to speak up more and I just jump in.
transcript.zh: 但是最近我试着多发表意见

transcript.en: And I've noticed an interesting thing.
transcript.zh: 我投入到讨论中并发现了一件有趣的事情

transcript.en: I've noticed that if they thought my point was interesting and new, then the next time they actually asked for my opinion, and then it was much easier for me to be part of the discussion.
transcript.zh: 我发现如果他们认为我的观点很有趣或新颖，下一次他们就会询问我的意见，这就使我顺利的加入到讨论中去。

transcript.en: That's great, Hiroko.
transcript.zh: 太好了

transcript.en: I hope that happens for me next semester - I'll have to work hard to find some interesting points.
transcript.zh: 希望下学期我也能这样，我得努力学习找出一些有趣的观点。

transcript.en: What help you to find these ideas?
transcript.zh: 什么能帮你找出这些观点？

transcript.en: I think that one thing that helped me with this was the reading.
transcript.zh: 我认为是读书帮了我。

transcript.en: I've had to do so much reading this semester just to help me to make sense of the lectures.
transcript.zh: 这学期我不得不读很多的书，以帮我理解讲课的内容。

transcript.en: At first I couldn't understand what the lecturers were talking about, so I had to turn to the books and journals.
transcript.zh: 起初，我不明白老师在讲什么，所以我不得不看书和期刊。

transcript.en: Every night I read for hours, using the lists of references that were given, and I made pages of notes.
transcript.zh: 每晚我都照着参考书单读几个小时的书，我还做了很多页的笔记。

transcript.en: At breakfast, I read and read my notes again.
transcript.zh: 早餐时，我一遍遍地读我的笔记。

transcript.en: This habit has helped me to follow the ideas in the lectures, and it's also given me some ideas to use in the tutorials.
transcript.zh: 这个习惯帮我跟上了讲课的思路，并且在讨论课上带给我许多启发。

transcript.en: But I did so much readings anyway - I don't think there's any time left over for anything extra.
transcript.zh: 但是我也做了许多阅读，我认为没有什么时间做这些额外的事情。

transcript.en: My reading speed is still quite slow, though I'm much better at dealing with vocabulary than I used to be.
transcript.zh: 我的读书速度还是很慢，尽管我现在比过去在处理词汇上要好很多。

transcript.en: What else do you think we could add to the course program to help with this reading problem?
transcript.zh: 你们认为我们在课堂项目上可以加点什么来解决阅读问题呢

transcript.en: There's not really anything because it's my problem.
transcript.zh: 没有什么，因为这是我的问题。

transcript.en: I remember we were given long articles to read.
transcript.zh: 我记得我们曾经要读长篇文章。

transcript.en: We didn't like that but now I realise that reading those long articles was good preparation for the things I need to read now.
transcript.zh: 我那时不喜欢，但是现在我意识到读长篇文章对于我现在的阅读是一种很好的准备。

transcript.en: Also, in class we regularly had speed-reading tasks to do, and we kept a record of our reading speed, so the teachers were encouraging us to work on that.
transcript.zh: 另外，我们在课上定期会有快速阅读要做，我们对阅读的速度计时，因此老师鼓励我们这样做。

transcript.en: That's true, Spiros, but what we read could have been different.
transcript.zh: 没错，Spiros，但是我们读得本可以不同。

transcript.en: Sometimes in the English class I felt frustrated when I had to read articles about the environment or health or education, because I wanted to concentrate on my own field, but we didn't read anything about engineering.
transcript.zh: 有时在英语课上，当我读环境、健康或教育的文章时，我总感到受挫，因为我想专注于我的领域，但是我们读不到任何关于工程学的文章。

transcript.en: So, I think I wasted some time learning vocabulary I didn't need.
transcript.zh: 所以，有时我觉得我在浪费时间学一些我用不着的词汇。

transcript.en: But surely this strategies you were taught for dealing with that vocabulary were helpful.
transcript.zh: 但是教你处理词汇的方法肯定是有用的。

transcript.en: Yes, but psychologically speaking, I would have felt much better working on reading from my own field.
transcript.zh: 是的，但是从心理上说，我更喜欢读自己领域的文章

transcript.en: What do you think Spiros?
transcript.zh: Spiros，你觉得呢？

transcript.en: I agree: that would have helped my confidence too, and I would have been more motivated.
transcript.zh: 我同意，这也会提高我的自信心，使我更有动力。

transcript.en: And it was good though that we could work on our own topics when we wrote the research assignments.
transcript.zh: 当我们写研究作业的时候，这对于我们研究的题目也有帮助。

transcript.en: Okay, let's move on to writing now...
transcript.zh: 好的，现在谈谈写作……
